description.value:
“The first ritual was just the second time anyone agreed to do something on purpose.”

Ritual Memory. During a Soma Break, you can lead your party in a 30-minute coalition ritual — a song, a meal, a story, a marking. At the end of the rest, each willing creature who participated gains a single d4 they may add to one attribute check, attack roll, or defense check before the next a Soma Break. Once the d4 is used or the next a Soma Break begins, it is spent.

Coalition Calm. While you are within 5 feet of an ally, that ally has reroll the lowest die on defense checks [TODO(adv-call)] against being Shaken.
